title: The Context, Meaning and Scope of Tourism

sentences.en: A. Travel has existed since the beginning of time, when primitive man set out, often traversing great distances in search of game, which provided the food and clothing necessary for his survival.
sentences.zh: A. 旅行自古以来就存在,当原始人出发时,经常长途跋涉去寻找猎物,这为他的生存提供了必需的食物和衣服。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Throughout the course of history, people have travelled for purposes of trade, religious conviction, economic gain, war, migration, and other equally compelling motivations.
sentences.zh: 纵观历史进程,人们出于贸易、宗教信仰、经济利益、战争、移民和其他同样令人信服的动机而旅行。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In the Roman era, wealthy aristocrats and high government officials also travelled for pleasure.
sentences.zh: 在罗马时代,富有的贵族和政府高官也为了享乐而旅行。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Seaside resorts located at Pompeii and Herculaneum afforded citizens the opportunity to escape to their vacation villas in order to avoid the summer heat of Rome.
sentences.zh: 位于庞贝和赫库兰尼姆的海滨度假胜地为公民提供了逃到度假别墅以避免罗马夏季炎热的机会。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Travel, except during the Dark Ages, has continued to grow and, throughout recorded history, has played a vital role in the development of civilisations and their economies.
sentences.zh: 除黑暗时代外,旅行一直在持续增长,并且在整个历史记录中,在文明及其经济的发展中发挥着至关重要的作用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: B. Tourism in the mass form as we know it today is a distinctly twentieth-century phenomenon.
sentences.zh: B. 我们今天所知的大众形式的旅游业是一个明显的二十世纪现象。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Historians suggest that the advent of mass tourism began in England during the industrial revolution with the rise of the middle class and the availability of relatively inexpensive transportation.
sentences.zh: 历史学家认为,随着中产阶级的崛起和相对廉价的交通的出现,大众旅游的出现始于工业革命期间的英国。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The creation of the commercial airline industry following the Second World War and the subsequent development of the jet aircraft in the 1950s signalled the rapid growth and expansion of international travel.
sentences.zh: 第二次世界大战后商业航空业的创建以及随后 20 世纪 50 年代喷气式飞机的发展标志着国际旅行的快速增长和扩张。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This growth led to the development of a major new industry: tourism.
sentences.zh: 这种增长导致了一个重要的新产业的发展：旅游业。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In turn, international tourism became the concern of a number of world governments since it not only provided new employment opportunities but also produced a means of earning foreign exchange.
sentences.zh: 反过来,国际旅游业也成为世界各国政府关注的焦点,因为它不仅提供了新的就业机会,而且还产生了赚取外汇的手段。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: C. Tourism today has grown significantly in both economic and social importance.
sentences.zh: C. 如今旅游业的经济和社会重要性都显着增长。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In most industrialised countries over the past few years the fastest growth has been seen in the area of services.
sentences.zh: 在过去几年中,大多数工业化国家增长最快的领域是服务业。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: One of the largest segments of the service industry, although largely unrecognised as an entity in some of these countries, is travel and tourism.
sentences.zh: 服务业最大的部分之一是旅行和旅游业,尽管在其中一些国家基本上未被承认为一个实体。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: According to the World Travel and Tourism Council (1992), ‘Travel and tourism is the largest industry in the world on virtually any economic measure including value-added capital investment, employment and tax contributions.
sentences.zh: 根据世界旅行和旅游理事会 (1992) 的说法,“从几乎所有经济指标来看,包括增值资本投资、就业和税收贡献,旅行和旅游业都是世界上最大的产业。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In 1992, the industry's gross output was estimated to be $3.5 trillion, over 12 per cent of all consumer spending.
sentences.zh: 1992 年,该行业的总产值估计为 3.5 万亿美元,占所有消费者支出的 12% 以上。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The travel and tourism industry is the world's largest employer with almost 130 million jobs, or almost 7 per cent of all employees.
sentences.zh: 旅行和旅游业是世界上最大的雇主,提供近 1.3 亿个就业岗位,占所有雇员的近 7%。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This industry is the world's leading industrial contributor, producing over 6 percent of the world's gross national product and accounting for capital investment in excess of $422 billion in direct, indirect and personal taxes each year.
sentences.zh: 该行业是世界领先的工业贡献者,产生了世界国民生产总值的 6% 以上,每年直接、间接和个人税收的资本投资超过 4,220 亿美元。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Thus, tourism has a profound impact both on the world economy and, because of the educative effect of travel and the effects on employment, on society itself.
sentences.zh: 因此,旅游业不仅对世界经济产生深远的影响,而且由于旅行的教育作用和对就业的影响,对社会本身也产生了深远的影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: D. However, the major problems of the travel and tourism industry that have hidden, or obscured, its economic impact are the diversity and fragmentation of the industry itself.
sentences.zh: D. 然而,旅行和旅游业隐藏或掩盖其经济影响的主要问题是该行业本身的多样性和碎片化。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The travel industry includes: hotels, motels and other types of accommodation; restaurants and other food services; transportation services and facilities; amusements, attractions and other leisure facilities; gift shops and a large number of other enterprises.
sentences.zh: 旅游业包括：酒店、汽车旅馆和其他类型的住宿；餐馆和其他餐饮服务；交通服务和设施；娱乐、景点和其他休闲设施；礼品店和大量其他企业。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Since many of these businesses also serve local residents, the impact of spending by visitors can easily be overlooked or underestimated.
sentences.zh: 由于其中许多企业也为当地居民提供服务,因此游客消费的影响很容易被忽视或低估。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: In addition, Meis (1992) points out that the tourism industry involves concepts that have remained amorphous to both analysts and decision makers.
sentences.zh: 此外,Meis (1992) 指出,旅游业所涉及的概念对于分析师和决策者来说仍然是不明确的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Moreover, in all nations this problem has made it difficult for the industry to develop any type of reliable or credible tourism information base in order to estimate the contribution it makes to regional, national and global economies.
sentences.zh: 此外,在所有国家,这个问题使得该行业很难开发任何类型的可靠或可信的旅游信息库,以估计其对区域、国家和全球经济的贡献。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: However, the nature of this very diversity makes travel and tourism ideal vehicles for economic development in a wide variety of countries, regions or communities.
sentences.zh: 然而,这种多样性的本质使得旅行和旅游业成为许多国家、地区或社区经济发展的理想工具。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: E. Once the exclusive province of the wealthy, travel and tourism have become an institutionalised way of life for most of the population.
sentences.zh: E. 旅行和旅游业曾经是富人的专属领域,现在已成为大多数人的制度化生活方式。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In fact, McIntosh and Goeldner (1990) suggest that tourism has become the largest commodity in international trade for many nations and, for a significant number of other countries, it ranks second or third.
sentences.zh: 事实上,McIntosh 和 Goeldner (1990) 认为,旅游业已成为许多国家国际贸易中最大的商品,而对于许多其他国家来说,旅游业排名第二或第三。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For example, tourism is the major source of income in Bermuda, Greece, Italy, Spain, Switzerland and most Caribbean countries.
sentences.zh: 例如,旅游业是百慕大、希腊、意大利、西班牙、瑞士和大多数加勒比国家的主要收入来源。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In addition, Hawkins and Ritchie, quoting from data published by the American Express Company, suggest that the travel and tourism industry is the number one ranked employer in the Bahamas, Brazil, Canada, France, (the former) West Germany, Hong Kong, Italy, Jamaica, Japan, Singapore, the United Kingdom and the United States.
sentences.zh: 此外,霍金斯和里奇引用美国运通公司公布的数据表明,旅行和旅游业是巴哈马、巴西、加拿大、法国、（前）西德、香港、意大利、牙买加、日本、新加坡、英国和美国排名第一的雇主。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: However, because of problems of definition, which directly affect statistical measurement, it is not possible with any degree of certainty to provide precise, valid or reliable data about the extent of world-wide tourism participation or its economic impact.
sentences.zh: 然而,由于直接影响统计测量的定义问题,不可能以任何程度的确定性提供有关全球旅游参与程度或其经济影响的精确、有效或可靠的数据。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: In many cases, similar difficulties arise when attempts are made to measure domestic tourism.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下,当试图衡量国内旅游业时,也会出现类似的困难。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。
